steps: Select a B Positive Plasma center near you on the official site and schedule your first donation appointment (appointments recommended; some locations accept walk-ins).
Attend your first visit: verify eligibility, complete registration, and pass the medical exam/screening.
Complete plasma donations up to twice a week (at least one calendar day between donations) during your first month to accrue toward the new-donor total.
Compensation is paid to the reloadable B Positive Visa debit card issued at your first donation.
